{{Top|leg}}
'''Males-Who-Die-For-The-Hive-Mother''' was the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] translation from the [[Verpine (language)|Verpine]] of the term used to describe [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] whose sole purpose was to protect the hive mother.
